caveats: Overall policy verdict NO_VERDICT and analysis coverage INCOMPLETE (RESOURCE_GAPS, MISSING_RESOURCE_CELLS) mean the workload-01 resource verdict in particular is not evaluated; missing cells are not evidence of health or of absence of a problem.

Correlation analysis is not informative here: all 9 pairs are INSUFFICIENT_DATA with partial_rho null, uncertainty NOT_ESTIMATED, and headline selection UNAVAILABLE. Absence of a stored partial correlation does not prove absence of a causal relationship.

Anomaly checks tested 5 series and produced only 1 CANDIDATE episode (db-queue); NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE on other series is not proof of stability, especially for response time whose anomaly reference MAD is 18008 ms.

Clock alignment is not verified by core; the resource binding covers explicit windows 1704067200000–1704067500000 while the run extends to 1704067559987, so windows cover only part of the run.

The workload-01 system-db-work series is missing 10 of 180 cells (RESOURCE_GAPS); the stored threshold finding for the observed portion does not give a window-level verdict, so NO_VERDICT must not be read as PASS.
